tickets.title: Failed jobs leave Home once superseded
tickets.what: docs/design/home-progress/README.md slice 1 HOME-SUPERSEDE with owner answers (D-2026-11-22-14): persist retry_of, stamp observed_at on retry; a failed/stopped job is superseded by a retry/repair, a newer job on the same target, or a landed slice/ticket; superseded failures leave Home, lane tops, hud_read({}) and Recommended (a reveals them muted); unhandled failures leave Home after 30 minutes; a stale AI brief never shows once its inputs changed.

acceptance.text: A failed job whose retry landed is gone from Home at once and visible muted under a
An unhandled failure leaves Home after 30 minutes and hud_read({}) still reports it

tickets.title: Progress rollup and derived ticket states
tickets.what: Design slice 2 ROLLUP-TRUTH: Home collector joins live jobs; whole-project ticket totals; feature tags roll into the current milestone; cross-feature <feature>/<NN> blockers; queued (waiting on an unfinished predecessor) apart from stalled; ticket working/try/done derived at read time from jobs, STATE, commits naming the ticket and accepted tries; hud_tickets accepts claimed/done and <feature>/<NN>; hud_create takes optional ticket/slice. Spec §2.1.7 and §2.2.4 sentences as told to the owner.

acceptance.text: A ticket whose slice landed shows to try without editing its file; accepted shows done
A ticket waiting on an unfinished predecessor shows queued, not blocked
